authorization: User permits fruitful deviations and parallel GPU experiments
hypothesis: Constrain the useful rounded E90 repair to leave the donor linear action unchanged on independent target prompt keys; repair unrelated behavior without undoing target absence
formula: C0=published_E90.float32-donor.float32; QF=orth(full numerical span of donor target unit keys); C=C0-(C0@QF)@QF.T; Wout=BF16(donor.float32+C)
optimization: C is the Frobenius-nearest correction to C0 subject to C QF=0 in exact arithmetic; this is our constrained-repair proposal, not a validated result from AlphaEdit
candidates: Native donor-copy identity first; one full constrained correction only. No strength/rank/energy sweep, no stacking. Candidate launch conditional on fixed blend ladder having no original sprint-qualified result. Code/tests may proceed concurrently.
surface: Same exact98bias-free serialized linears, layers12-19 and28-33. All other canonical tensors equal clean. Standalone model with clean tokenizer and complete fresh namespace/tied-alias reload.

capture.positions: only last nonpadding token of complete rendered prompt; no generated or teacher-forced answers

basis.method: float64 CPU thin SVD of uncentered unit-key matrix; preserve entire numerical span

application.arithmetic: FP32 with TF32 disabled, row chunks128; one final native BF16 cast
application.identity: native donor files; no subtract/add identity
application.precast_CF_report: report absolute and relative to C0F; normalize diagnostic by ||C0||F*||F||F
application.norm_and_pythagorean: require constrained correction norm <= C0 norm and orthogonal residual decomposition within1e-5relative tolerance
application.postcast: report actual (Wout32-donor32)QF and F, including ratio to C0F. No exact BF16 preservation claim; reject nonfinite quantities.
